location: Wyoming Oil and Gas Conservation Commission 2211 King Blvd
title: The purpose of this meeting is to continue the Select Committee's interim work. The Select Committee will receive information and updates from the Wyoming Water Development Office on water project applications, amendments and contracts. The Select Committee will also discuss interim topics, which include: (1) stormwater infrastructure; 2) consumptive use of water; 3) the Colorado River; 4) water management in Wyoming; and 5) transfer of lands to the State of Wyoming.
